name: Create VibeDesktop component for vibe mode
description:
# Conversation Summary

1. **VibeDesktop Component Created**: Built a new `VibeDesktop.vue` component that renders a single active app without tabs, providing a simplified interface for vibe mode users.

2. **Store Enhancement**: Updated `ui.js` to track app opening timestamps (`openedAt`) and automatically set the most recently opened app as the active app when another closes.

3. **Smart App State Management**: Modified `showApp()` and `closeApp()` mutations to intelligently switch between apps based on chronological order, maintaining a single `activeApp` reference.

4. **TeamView Mode Switching**: Enhanced `TeamView.vue` to conditionally render either `Desktop` (expert mode with tabs) or `VibeDesktop` (vibe mode with single app view) based on `viewMode` setting.

5. **Seamless Integration**: Leveraged existing component architecture to ensure compatibility with all registered apps while providing a distraction-free experience for vibe mode users.

messages.content:
When working with vibe view mode all apps will be shown on the same team view body instead using the Desktop view that allows having multiple tabs.
Based on Desktop create a View that renders last app opened only and use it in the TabView for vibe mode. Or if it's possible better to make Desktop work with simple add mode without tabs and resuse the apps list
Use activeApp to know the app to show in vibe mode. When opening apps use a timestampt so when state is restored we know which was the last app open and set to activeApp
